text:
olivia: Planning to cut candidate RC-10011 during the 23:30 UTC change window. Need sheriff, deploy lead, KV warm, and an explicit rollback snippet. Can someone pick up sheriff?
deploy-bot: RC-10011 created from branch `release/qa@b7f3e1`. Artifacts pinned: `router-proxy:10011` (sha: 0a1b2c3d). Preflight available: `deploy-bot preflight --rc=10011 --kv-warm`.
kevin: I can sheriff 23:15-00:15 UTC. Will watch traces and error budget. :thumbsup:
mira: There's a queued client-mapping change that touches the routing table; owner agreed to hold merge until 00:45 UTC.
tom_oncall: Rollback plan should be short and deterministic. Proposed manual rollback steps:
```
# step 1: revert image to known-good
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/router-proxy router-proxy=redwood/router-proxy:10002
# step 2: flip routing flag back
curl -s -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"alpha_routing":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
```
henry_release: Please pin a one-line release note in changelog and add a short customer blurb. I'll take deploy lead.
olivia: Run preflight now and attach the smoke logs. If KV warm fails we do not cut.
deploy-bot: Preflight running: KV warm (staging) in progress. Smoke tests queued (route sanity, short-gen).
deploy-bot: Preflight results: KV warm OK (primed 9/9 keys). Smoke: 2/2 passed (route and embed). Latency p95 within 115% baseline. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rc10011/preflight (internal link).
kevin: Good. I've updated the runbook with rollback URL https://wiki.redwood/ops/rc-10011-rollback and added the client-mapping owner hold.
henry_release: Roles locked: Kevin = sheriff, Henry = deploy lead, Tom = rollback exec, Olivia = coordinator, Mira = migration hold. Any objections to 23:30 UTC promo?
mira: No objections from me. Migration owner will keep the PR unmerged until 00:45.
tom_oncall: If canary error rate >4% or latency p95 >2x, I'll abort and execute the rollback above.
deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: RC-10011 -> prod at 23:30 UTC. Canary plan: 1% for 6m, 20% for 12m, then 100%. Auto-fallback to image 10002 if health degrade >4% or error spike detected.
olivia: Thanks team  final check-in at 23:25 for go/no-go. See you then. :rocket:
